reviews.text: Sales Representatives and Manufacturing Shop Management were all knowledgeable about their product and very friendly and helpful during the purchase. This was the third building we have purchased and a great product. All have been built on site to our specifications.
reviews.author: Wayne Young

reviews.text: After speaking with Lisa several times about our needs and wants for a shed, the school that I work for decided to purchase a 4 x 8 custom built lean-to shed to serve as a guard shack. They were very quick and efficient, the structure is amazing and they took care of it with no issues. A mini split was installed, and the maintenance man is finishing the inside himself. The structure is extremely sturdy and from a bare concrete slab to finished product was about 3 1/2 hours. They arrived at 10 AM promptly with all the materials and by 130 the very knowledgeable and skilled crew had a completed shed built. I cannot recommend Ulrich enough to anybody who has storage needs
reviews.author: Brandon Morales

reviews.text: Jake at Ulrich was great in finding a fit for what we were looking for. We ended up with two matching buildings one for guest & one for a future office. We finished out the inside and they turned out great. Perfect for what is needed at this time. They delivered & were great at getting in the right area. Very nice people to work with and great at finding what you are looking for if your not ready to customize. Keri-
reviews.author: kelby Griffin

reviews.text:
I love my shed. It is affordable and very well made. I love having my things close by instead of a storage unit across town.
I appreciate the help i received in choosing the additions and colors. The website was easy to maneuver and i love the finished product. It is bigger inside than i expected and that is wonderful for me. I love it.
reviews.author: Donna Kennedy

reviews.text: Thank you soo much to Britney Kincaid for all your help and care for designing a home shed for my papa and making sure all his requests were done to his specifications. He absolutely love it. And cannot wait for it to be delivered onto our property in a month. Thank you for everything ❤️ ♥️ we appreciate you and look forward to working with you again. Best wishes, Amy Afalava
reviews.author: Leaumau Finai Afalava

reviews.text: Ulrich provided our custom Garden Shed, made to fit an existing concrete slab.  It came out just how we hoped!  The customer rep Jayden was very helpful in the design phase, and the onsite builders were very careful and efficient.  Photos posted.
reviews.author: June Lay

reviews.text: Three years ago, I ordered a custom shed. It was built and delivered on time. The shed is flawless and well built and has performed well in the past three years I liked it so much that I ordered another shed exactly like the first one. Ulrich truly does stand behind their work and provides excellent support to their customers. I want to thank my salesman, Brady, delivery manager Trey, delivery person Ray, and Manuel for performing paint touchup on the new shed. I looked at some of the big name competitor's and the build did not seem quite as good as Ulrich. I tried to match the build and once I was complete with all the options the new shed was more expensive at their competitors so I can say Ulrich is very price competitive and coupled with the quality of the new build my order was a no-brainer.
reviews.author: Bob Musselman

reviews.text: Ulrich shed was among one of several shed companies we researched and visited. Out of all the companies Ulrich was the company we chose. We felt that Ulrich's sheds had the best quality, gave multiple design options, and had the style that we liked the best. Once we began the purchasing process we had Angie as our sales representative and she was amazing. She was very patient, walked us through all the options, and even referred us to a physical location so that we could go in person to see the different styles and options before finalizing our purchase. After that, we were assigned to Tyler to finalize the building process. We encountered some issues and the company worked quickly to resolve them. The owner contacted us directly to ensure we were going to be satisfied with our purchase. Ulrich assisted us with the permit process and once the permit was approved we were on the schedule to get the shed built onsite. Our shed builder was Bob. Bob worked smoothly and efficiently. He took the time to ensure that every detail and feature was exact and the finished product was exactly what we wanted. Ulrich shed is definitely a company we would recommend and we are very pleased with our final product.
reviews.author: Marlon Moore

reviews.text: What an amazing experience it was dealing with Brady Bates building my dream shed! My she shed came out even better than I could’ve ever imagined. The service I received was $1 million experience.
reviews.author: Merrill Schiller

reviews.text: This was my second building from ulrich. The first experience was great everything went as I was told this time nothing went as planned. I ordered a building from Fort Worth store was told it would be 3 weeks at worst for delivery it was almost 5 weeks I had a tight fit going through a gate took pictures showed sales person and al  see sent them to project manager both said no problem it would fit. Delivery guy comes gyres what dose not fit so he had to take gate out now I’m out more money get it put back in . Jay the delivery guy was great about all the extra effort he had to do to bad the rest of the team was so bad. I could have ordered a narrower building. 5 years sure made a big difference in the company to bad it’s the wrong way
reviews.author: Richard Wilson

reviews.text: Again Britney Kincade you have come through for me and my family first fir my Papa now for my son. My son's shed/studio will be delivered on September 12th. I want to Truly that you for taking the time and care for working within his needs and budget. You are the best. Thank you for you patience and your professionalism. You outdid yourself and you have made lifetime customers of me and our entire extended family.  May you forever have light shined upon you and loved ones. Forever Grateful Amy  Finai Afalava.
reviews.author: MaMas Afalava

reviews.text: Love this shed. Super professional and took the needs of my small space into account. Did the job in one day. They normally build it and bring it in but since we had a small area they brought it all in pieces and built in place, painted, finished it and we really appreciated that. As real estate agents we needed a place to hang signed it’s perfect

reviews.text: Great experience selecting and configuring my shed and working with the Ulrich folks.  The shed is well designed and well constructed.  The one-man crew was the definition of a high-quality and high-efficiency builder.  It was a pleasure watching him construct my shed.  No problems or complaints at all.  Great job!  Highly recommend these folks and their storage sheds.

reviews.text: Ulrich built a storage building and studio for us, and did a great job. They built the storage building in one day, and the studio in two days. We were so satisfied that we recommended them to my son-in-law, who, like me, is also an artist. They are scheduled to have one built. The building materials and craftsmanship area superior.

reviews.text: I don't have a huge backyard and needed something a little smaller that your typical 8'x10' layout. Ulrich had all the sizes and styles I was after at very competitive pricing. I went into the location and they walked me through the design process. All very simple and transparent. Once i picked what i liked, they built it on site within 2 weeks, which was much earlier than the original deadline. The building itself was very quick and efficient. I was very pleased with their work and overall result of entire purchase. Would definitely use them again for other similar needs.
reviews.author: Roberto Trevino

reviews.text: Loved our Shed! Bob did a great job even in this Texas heat. Kudos to him.
reviews.author: Elaine Robles

reviews.text:
I had a 500+ square foot shed built, which turned out very nice. The low rating is directly related to the need for more communication from the post-sales customer service team. I have called many times regarding areas that needed to be fixed, such as my metal door, which was bent and has resulted in water getting into the shed. The lack of responsiveness is very disappointing and will prevent me from buying from Ulrich in the future.

Jim was sales person and was amazing. He has provided with several contact to resolve this issue however no one from that contact list has returned my calls.
reviews.author: Eddie Barnes

reviews.text:
After exploring various options for a shed, we ultimately chose UlRich for its competitive pricing and quality builds. Tyler provided excellent customer service, and we finalized our purchase with ease. Highly recommended!

Thanks for making the process so simplified !
reviews.author: Lorrie Hadder

reviews.text:
Update: their message was for me to contact them about my review. Haha. No one called me back. I could have seen that one coming!

Beware!

I began the process with Ulrich Lifestyle in December 2023, and after many frustrating months, we finally completed the project. The communication throughout the entire process was atrocious. If you were lucky enough to get someone to call you back, everything they said was a lie.

After the shed was built onsite, I discovered that, due to its size (12x20), a permit was required. When I inquired about this, they told me it was my responsibility to obtain the permits. Leaving such a crucial task up to the customer is absurd. I spent months going back and forth with them about permitting, which eventually required an engineer to approve the specs.

Fortunately, I anticipated issues and documented everything—I have recordings and emails of all the lies I was told. One of the main representatives who misled me is no longer with the company, according to the last person I spoke with. Oh, and I was told that I’m a “difficult customer/project” and that’s why I don’t hear back.  I guess demanding an update after 8 attempts of Months of trying makes me a “difficult customer/project”

Beware of this company. There is no way they should continue their business practices this way. I strongly advise against using Ulrich Lifestyle.
reviews.author: Christopher Seibert

reviews.text: First off, the final product was good. The guy who did the actually building was excellent. Getting there and follow through was a struggle. For example, as the project neared completion I called and asked them to install a skirt around the shed. I had to call and text the project manager several times to get an estimate. When he finally called back he told me they would not install a skirt unless I had ordered it in the initial design. Ridiculous. Getting a permit from the city of Dallas was difficult and lengthy. Surprisingly after I got upset about it the permit got issued. To be fair, Dallas has a reputation for slow issuing of permits. Bottom line, once the sale is made I didn’t find communication to be very good and the skirt issue baffles me. Since I first called while the shed was still being built I was shocked at the lack of flexibility. Like a lot of businesses, the sales people do a good job but once the money is paid, it’s difficult to get a response after. Again, for the most part the final project was great. Just know if you do business with them you will have to be the one to constantly call and text to get a response. And most important, make sure you have every design detail you want in the original proposal or you’ll be looking to find somebody else to finish the work.
reviews.author: Rod Lake

reviews.text: Ulrich is a top notch operation! Great experience dealing with Brady Bates, Trey, and Hector Pacheco. They did an excellent job building a new shed in my backyard!  I highly recommend their service. Thank you guys🙏

reviews.text:
I purchased a 12' x 24' lofted barn form Ulrich after looking at a lot of other barns.The construction and quality of this building is superb to the buildings that I have looked at. I was impressed by what the sales representative told me and then showed me in their sales lot. The installer was skilled with over 30 years of building experience and was very well organized in building my barn on site. I watched the construction from start to finish and I'm glad that I decided on this barn. The construction standards and material quality used by Ulrich is well researched and improved year after year.
I have already highly recommended Ulrich to others that I know. My thanks to my sales representative, Robert Marshall for his help and speedy delivery of my new barn.

reviews.text: Every aspect of the dealings has been extraordinary. From going out to view the different sheds, the sales representative with his knowledge of the business/quality of the buildings/ eagerness to satisfy. The billing department have been prompt and accurate. The timeliness of drawing the payment my account. They have responded to my calls and supplied me with the answers I needed, with a cheerful , and professional attitude. The shed has been fantastic. It is well constructed, durable and beautiful. I can not think of a single negative thing to say about Ulrich Barn Builders.
reviews.author: gina bradley

reviews.text:
I thought it was great. Until I needed a repair. During the purchase process they had promised over and over that the shed is warrantied and blah blah blah

I wrote in because after just a few months water is coming in through the door threshold, they asked for a photo of the door then texted me that my warranty claim had been denied because I put stairs up. The stairs were installed BELOW the level of the subfloor and had absolutely no impact to the threshold.

The guy on the phone, Zach was incredibly unhelpful, just repeating that he would work up a quote for the cost. He was completely unwilling to even send someone out to actualyl inspect the issue, instead saying he would send someone if I paid a fee. To inspect the building their builders built wrong...

Do not under any circumstances use Ulrich. You will pay MORE for an inferior product with no backing.
reviews.author: Nik Marr

reviews.text: I purchased an ulrich building 3 years ago and very happy with the quality. Went to purchase another one 3 weeks ago and the price has doubled.  However needed the building and placed a down payment. Slept on it and cancelled within 12 hours. Reached out to Dillon the sales boy and then had to go up the chain to  a “manager” Tyler who never answered a text or picked up the phone about refunding the down payment.  Finally disputed through the credit card.  Find a different Ulrich dealership.  Go down the road to Burleson. Night and day.
reviews.author: Bae Christus

reviews.text:
They built me a great shed, let me start with that. It's great quality, looks good, and reasonably priced.

However...

The initial sales call was excellent (Sorry, don't remember the salesalesmans name).
He helped me design exactly what I wanted.

Time from design to install (built on site in my case) was excellent.

But thats where it went off the rails.

The person who scheduled the install (I think his name was Zach) started off great, but flat ghosted me the day of install.
He had great energy and seemed like he really wanted to help.
Told me install would be started between 9am - 11am and to call him if the installer hadn't called me by 8:30. (I have the voice-mail saved where he states the start time.)

9am comes and goes and no call from the installer so I call Zach. Suddenly he wont talk to me or return my call.
10am I call again. Again Zach won't talk to me. The rep is did talk to was VERY rude and told me I was lying and that they only promise a day, not a time.
Again, I have a voice-mail saved where I am told otherwise.

Installer shows up at 1:30.
To be fair, the installer did a great job, just wish their customer service had been more honest from the start.

Would I ever order from them in the future?
Yes.
Just be aware that they may not show up when they say they will.
reviews.author: Craig Bevil

reviews.text: Brady, from this company far surpassed any customer service out there. He put up with my ridiculous questions for several days. After getting quotes from several companies, I chose this one based on the high level of customer service. If I could give him 10 stars, I would!!! Thank you!
reviews.author: MJ

reviews.text:
We could not be happier with our decision to use Ulrich. We took the time to closely evaluate various shed/building companies and Ulrich was the obvious choice. We were pleasantly surprised to find they were very competitive when we compared prices and options. Surprised, because Ulrich hands down stood out with their quality and craftsmanship.

We currently use our building as our workshop and storage shed, a 10x12 Lofted Barn that was built on site. The salesperson was pleasant to work with and very informative. The builder communicated well, was very respectful and happy to answer any of our questions.
reviews.author: Cynthia Meza

reviews.text:
As I was researching a shed for my new house I was directed to Ulrich because they supposedly had the best quality shed and their service was great. That has not been my experience at all. “Mike”, the sales guy, was very high-pressure and kept trying to get me to buy more shed than what I needed/wanted. I heard from “Mike” every day, sometimes twice a day asking me “if I am ready to buy that shed”. As soon as they had my 50% deposit (1/15/21) on the shed it has been absolutely pulling teeth to get anyone to respond to me. “Mike” 30 days after taking my deposit finally retuned one of my many calls to check on the status of permitting (which I was told takes 3 weeks, 5 weeks worse case because of COVID) and said that winter storms and COVID is making the process take longer but I should get my permit any day. At 50 days I tried calling and emailing again and could not get him to return my calls or emails. At 60+ days (last week) I finally called into the corporate office to see if I could talk to someone and I spoke with a “manager” who assured me they would have my permit by that Friday or Monday at the latest and gave me the number of the permit person “Bree” and I could call her any time to check on the status. I have since called her and left a voicemail twice and have yet to get a call back.

I am extremely frustrated! Not only do I not have my shed (or even my permit!) 70 days after they took my deposit I can’t event get them to answer my calls to check on the status. I would encourage people to go with Tuff Shed or another company. There is no way their service could be worse than I have experience with Ulrich.
reviews.author: Travis Patton

reviews.text: High quality, secure, reasonably priced storage shed.  Met their promised installation date.  Very satisfied, but I will say that it's difficult to make contact if you need to talk with someone once the sale is complete.

reviews.text: Completely professional and willing to work with you.  I got an 14'x10 shed and was delivered professionally as quite fast as well.  I walked it and it was build like a house.  I absolutely thought it would be a bit less stable but this could be a small house if needed.  I tried a shed from Lowes and unless you want to spend a week and extra money for supplies, go ahead.  This was something I never thought I could afford but with the rent to buy, I walked out a proud owner of a shed built better than my own house.  Don't pass them up because  you think you cant afford them!  Believe me you can!

data.summary: Reviews are overwhelmingly authentic. The high rating is supported by numerous detailed, credible positive reviews from repeat customers. The negative reviews are also highly specific and form a clear, consistent pattern of post-sale service and communication failures, which is a common issue in contracting.
